# Spaceman

> Spaceman is a tiling window manager for macOS on Apple silicon (macOS 14 or later), version 0.3.7. Windows open side by side instead of on top of each other, across ten numbered workspaces you switch with the keyboard, with ordered rules for where apps open, native-tab continuity, durable window restoration and a local CLI.

Spaceman uses macOS Accessibility APIs and needs no System Integrity Protection changes. It provides ten numbered workspaces (`1`–`10`) plus opt-in named workspaces (`A`–`Z`), nested weighted split layouts, drag-to-reorder and resize, and restores every hidden window on pause, quit or update. Window titles never leave memory, and it sends no telemetry.

## Install

- [Download for macOS](https://anoma.ly/spaceman/download/macos-arm64): version 0.3.7, Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later; Developer ID-signed and notarized.
- [SHA-256 checksum](https://anoma.ly/spaceman/download/macos-arm64.sha256): live SHA-256 checksum for `Spaceman.zip`.
- Terminal: `curl -fL https://anoma.ly/spaceman/download/macos-arm64 -o /tmp/Spaceman.zip && ditto -x -k /tmp/Spaceman.zip /Applications && open /Applications/Spaceman.app`
- Setup: a four-step tour (`Welcome` → `Give Spaceman window access` → `Your workspaces` → `Try it`) asks for Accessibility, suggests where your open windows go, and starts tiling only when you press `Arrange & start`, so your windows stay put until you say so. On macOS 27.3 and later, grant access in **System & App Protection Override** (the renamed Accessibility list) by clicking the Privacy & Security notification or the list's `+`; that list refuses dragged app tiles.

## Agents

- [Setup skill](https://anoma.ly/spaceman/skill.md): install, configure, verify, troubleshoot or uninstall Spaceman, including moving over from another window manager and recovering off-screen windows.
- [Full documentation](https://anoma.ly/spaceman/llms-full.txt): installation, keyboard shortcuts, configuration rules, CLI commands and recovery guarantees in one document.
- [Source and issues](https://github.com/anomalyco/spaceman): the public repository, changelog and releases.
